messages:
ellen: Aurora Health disputed a Dedicated burst charge on their May invoice. They say no heavy workloads ran during the window. Can ops pull attribution?

kevin: On it. Invoice ref they sent: Invoice 2026-05-10 line DEDICATED_BURST $2,900. Attached CSV of timestamps.

sam: I fetched pool logs for pool ah-dedicated-2. Quick sample: 
```
2026-05-04T02:08:11Z host-22 req=rz55 model=rw-7b tokens=12000 tenant=acct_7721
2026-05-04T02:08:12Z host-22 req=rz56 model=rw-7b tokens=18000 tenant=acct_6600
```
Most tokens map to acct_6600.

ellen: Who is acct_6600?

kevin: acct_6600 = beta-internal (partner). They have fallback enabled that may spill into Dedicated pools.

infra-bot: Alert routing-collision-2026-05-04 assigned to infra-team.

sam: Token split estimate ~82% acct_6600, ~18% Aurora. Overrun $2,900 -> chargeable share for acct_6600 = $2,378.00.

ellen: Propose: issue full refund to Aurora (CM-2026-05-AUR-01 $2,900), goodwill credit $75, and chargeback CB-2026-05-6600 $2,378. Approve?

kevin: Approve. Also recommend a short-term throttle on acct_6600 fallback and a routing rule change to respect per-pool affinity.

sam: Will prepare the credit & chargeback. billing-bot will update invoices.

billing-bot: Action: credit memo CM-2026-05-AUR-01 issued; new invoice 2026-05-10-v2 generated (burst removed). Chargeback invoice CB-2026-05-6600 created for $2,378.00.

ellen: Aurora confirmed receipt and appreciated the quick fix. Assigning postmortem to infra to prevent recurrence.

kevin: I'll own the routing rule patch. PR incoming.

sam: Closing thread, will follow up if partner disputes chargeback.
